integrity.method: complete exact finite enumeration with independent rational-score spot checks; analytic persistence argument

scientific_limitations: The sharp electorate-size bound is for exactly three candidates, two seats and exactly two abstainers using the Kelly set-valued preference extension.
Every tie at both sequential greedy stages is retained; the witness benefit is tie-mediated and is not a guarantee under arbitrary fixed resolute tie-breaking.
A complete finite enumeration supports the minimum size and orbit count; the infinite larger-electorate extension follows separately by adjoining universally approving voters.
Priority beyond the inspected publications and independent scientific audit remain unverified.
title: Sharp twelve-voter boundary for two-person group abstention under sequential PAV
